@Yamiche thank you for your reporting on the lives of people in Ferguson. Black people are still dealing with the same issues and trauma that existed 5 years ago when Mike Brown was murdered.

#MikeBrownForever 
#RIPMikeBrown 
#BlackLivesMatter

I'm actually surprised they finally fired Daniel Pantaleo for murdering Eric Garner. This still isn't justice but it is just.  Pantaleo should never be in a police uniform again.

#FirePantaleo 
#EricGarner 
#ICantBreathe
#BlackLivesMatter
